{{Youmay|the skin excretion of the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]]|the [[Denin|Naldar prince]]}}
'''Denin''' was a chemical that was excreted from the small, thin [[Hair/Legends|hairs]] that covered a [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix's]] body. The chemical changed the [[Color/Legends|color]] of a Vratix's skin, which was used to express emotion.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
